english.note: Use this for a paid household worker who mainly does domestic tasks rather than manages other servants.

examples.english: I hired a housekeeper to come twice a week to clean and cook for us.
examples.traditional: 我請咗個家務助理，每個星期嚟兩日幫我哋清潔同煮飯。
